task: Identify as many public-safety risk events as possible from a stream of microblog posts and call-center records on the evening of 2014-01-23 in Abila, Kronos. For each event, extract: time, location, people involved, and a short characterisation.
system_introduction:
ProactiveVA system for VAST 2021 MC3.
It contains five linked views:
  Map        — hexagon-grid heatmap of message volume, plus call-center incident markers. Click a hexagon to filter messages to that area; click again to deselect and see ungeotagged messages.
  Timeline   — message volume over time with sentiment colouring. Brush to filter messages by time range.
  Messages   — scrollable feed of microblog and call-center records. Hover to highlight; click to add a keyword filter.
  Graph      — entity-relation graph and key-entity word cloud. Click a node to filter messages mentioning that entity.
  Notes      — analyst's findings (title, label, view screenshot). The assistant may comment on note accuracy.

available_operations.name: read_data
available_operations.description: Read summary data from a view.

available_operations.name: select
available_operations.description: Select an element (hexagon id, message id, entity, …).

available_operations.name: filter
available_operations.description: Apply a filter to all linked views.

available_operations.name: highlight
available_operations.description: Visually highlight a set of messages.

available_operations.name: add_finding
available_operations.description: Append a finding to the Notes view.

available_operations.name: reply
available_operations.description: Send the final confirmation back to the user.

interaction_patterns.interpretation: User scrolls through the message list very quickly, hovering many items.
interaction_patterns.tip_template: Provide explanation of how messages are aggregated into the timeline / map heat.

interaction_patterns.interpretation: User pauses on a node in the entity graph for a long time without interacting.
interaction_patterns.tip_template: Provide explanation of the graph encoding (node size, edge meaning).

interaction_patterns.interpretation: User selects a keyword in the Messages view but does not move on to the timeline.
interaction_patterns.tip_template: Hint that clicking a keyword can be combined with the timeline brush.

interaction_patterns.interpretation: User selects a keyword, undoes it, selects another, slowly.
interaction_patterns.tip_template: Summarise what messages mentioning the keyword have in common.

interaction_patterns.interpretation: User scrolls through many messages without selecting, filtering, or noting.
interaction_patterns.tip_template: Identify and surface the most important features in the current message set.

interaction_patterns.interpretation: User repeatedly switches the time-brush range without progressing.
interaction_patterns.tip_template: Compare the two ranges and highlight similarities/differences for the user.

interaction_patterns.interpretation: User keeps revisiting the timeline as if checking that nothing was missed.
interaction_patterns.tip_template: Remind the user of any time gaps not covered by their notes.

interaction_patterns.interpretation: User retraces an earlier exploration path, suggesting a possible conflict.
interaction_patterns.tip_template: Check whether any submitted notes contradict each other.

interaction_patterns.interpretation: User toggles between views slowly, attempting to verify a fact.
interaction_patterns.tip_template: Verify the current finding against the underlying data.
